comment: ROMtool commercial wrap constants (phase E3, v0.6.0). EVERY commercial constant here is editable and nothing is hard-coded in romtool/commercial.py. DOCUMENTED WRAP ORDER (the recap $ chain, applied in exactly this sequence - mirrored on /how-it-works section 11 and in estimate.py's docstring): 1) DIRECT LABOR + SUPERVISION (wrapped lines: base minutes x condition x access x schedule = task hours; + N01 working-foreman + N02 non-working supervision hours, billed at the rate card) -> 2) DOWNTIME (M01 idle crew-day carry for blacked-out windows: schedule risk cost, zero hours) -> 3) SMALL-TOOLS/CONSUMABLES allowance (pct x (labor + downtime)) -> 4) ESCALATION ((index factor - 1) x (labor + downtime), where factor = 1 + days(base_date -> anchor_date)/365 x annual_rate_pct/100; the anchor date is the definition's commercial.escalation.anchor_date, else the midpoint working day of the with-crews schedule when the definition carries start_date; no anchor -> escalation not applied, factor 1 with a warning) -> 5) SALES/USE TAX (rate x taxable-line labor per the rules below) -> 6) INSURANCE/BOND carry (pct x running subtotal through tax) -> 7) PM (I05, pct x running subtotal through insurance) -> 8) OVERHEAD (pct x running subtotal through PM) -> 9) PROFIT (pct x running subtotal through OH, optionally by risk tier) -> 10) LINE-RISK CONTINGENCY (N05 per line by source quality, on labor dollars, never marked up) -> GRAND TOTAL. Percentages apply low/mid/high uniformly; contingency stays outside the marked-up subtotal.

small_tools.basis: pct x (direct labor incl. N01/N02 supervision + M01 idle carry)
small_tools.note: Small tools, consumables, blades/bits/fasteners wear allowance carried on accepted labor cost. Assumption-grade practice default (E): edit per company standard.

sales_use_tax.comment: Sales/use tax rules: every recap line is classified into a line type via zone prefix (catalog zone before the first '-') and the zone_line_types map; anything unmapped falls to default_line_type. Types listed in taxable_line_types are taxed at rate_pct (or the definition's commercial.tax.rate_pct jurisdiction override); types in exempt_line_types are not taxed. This recap prices LABOR (improvement to real property, exempt in most jurisdictions), so the shipped default classifies every zone as labor -> the tax step computes $0.00 and reports so explicitly. Classify a zone as equipment/materials (owner-furnished gear scope) only when your jurisdiction actually taxes that base.
sales_use_tax.rate_note: Default jurisdiction rate (assumption-grade placeholder, E): set 0 to disable or edit to your governing rate; definition commercial.tax.rate_pct overrides per estimate.

escalation.comment: Escalation indices: each index has a scope (which recap dollars it applies to - labor recap -> labor index), a base_date (price reference) and an annualized rate. Factor = 1 + days(base_date -> anchor_date)/365 x annual_rate_pct/100; anchor before base_date means factor 1 (never de-escalate). Days counted calendar, rate applied linearly (simple interest). Provenance: assumption-grade practice indices (E) for the ROM horizon - swap in published ENR/CPI series when vendor price-hold dates govern.

labor.note: Applied to (direct labor + M01 idle carry) when the estimate carries an anchor date.

copper.note: Material-scope index for copper-bearing scope; the v0.6 labor recap carries no material lines, so it does not hit the chain - reserved for material/quote-swap scope and future phases.

equipment.note: Equipment-scope index; same - reserved for equipment lines / quote swaps.

insurance_bond.basis: pct x running subtotal through taxes
insurance_bond.note: Builder's all-risk + general liability + performance/payment bond carry, as a single wrapped rate (assumption-grade practice default, E: split/carve out per program).

overtime.note: Schedule-level rule: planned crew hours above the weekly threshold are flagged on /estimates/{id}/schedule with the double-time multiplier noted. OT COST is NOT a wrap step - the M02 night/weekend hour differentials remain the labor-costing mechanism; this flag documents where a straight->DT premium would apply.

cash_flow.comment: Milestone schedule and % splits of the wrapped grand total (mid band). Splits must sum to exactly 100. Patterns: 'upfront' = billed in the NTP month; 'months' = spread evenly across `months` starting `offset_months` after month 0; 'schedule' (INSTALL) = spread evenly across the calendar months the installation schedule spans (with start_date), else ceil(schedule work days / workdays_per_month_default) months; 'final' = the last month of the curve (closeout/retainage release).

profit_tier_note: Definition commercial.profit_risk_tier (low/standard/high) overrides estimating.json profit_pct; default tier 'standard' matches the 10% rate card so legacy totals are unchanged unless an estimate picks a tier.

bid_form.signature_note: Bid valid per attachment terms; base bid excludes named alternates unless separately accepted; alternates are priced with the same wrap engine and are additive unless marked deduct.
bid_form.unit_price_note: Unit price = wrapped grand total (mid) / antenna-point count from the estimate definition.
